rysen-works.title: RYSEN WORKS
rysen-works.summary: An internal system for orders, delivery dates, inventory, and approvals
rysen-works.background: RYSEN Works brings order stages, delivery reminders, inventory, and administrative approvals into one web system, with Chinese and Korean interfaces.
rysen-works.solution: The workbench summarizes due dates and in-progress stages. Orders are tracked from open to complete. The calendar color-codes deliveries, milestones, and leave. Inventory covers stock and movements. Approvals include leave, sick leave, expenses, and internal proposals.

massconnected.title: MASSCONNECTED
massconnected.summary: A marketplace where buyers post manufacturing needs and verified factories quote online
massconnected.background: Buyers publish a request by process and upload drawings. Verified factories quote online, and standard parts can be purchased from the in-house shop.
massconnected.solution: The site also publishes cases, news, and a blog around the path from request to purchase.
